Class NutritionService

java.lang.Object
service.NutritionService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Service
public class NutritionService extends Object implements Service
Service layer responsible for managing Nutrition entities.

This class provides business operations such as creation, retrieval, update, deletion, filtering, and JSON serialization of nutrition data. It acts as an intermediary between higher-level components and the NutritionDao.
